# PlantUML Power Editor

> Free online PlantUML editor at https://plantuml-editor.com. Write UML diagrams as text in the browser and see them render live. Runs entirely client-side (PlantUML compiled to JavaScript); diagrams are stored in the browser's local storage and never uploaded.

## Features

- Live rendering; the last valid diagram stays visible while typing, errors are shown at the affected line
- Syntax highlighting and context-aware autocompletion (sequence, class, activity, use case, component, state, deployment, object, mind map and more)
- Click a rendered element to jump to its source line or to change its style (colors, fonts, borders, line style)
- Diagram-wide styles: PlantUML themes, hand-drawn look, custom themes saved locally
- Export as PNG (1×/2×/4×, optional transparency) or SVG, copy to clipboard, download .puml source
- Sidebar with saved diagrams (search, rename, duplicate, delete with undo)
- UI in English and German (`?lang=en`, `?lang=de`), light and dark mode

## Links

- [Editor (English)](https://plantuml-editor.com/?lang=en)
- [Editor (Deutsch)](https://plantuml-editor.com/?lang=de)
- [About this project](https://plantuml-editor.com/about.html): private project by a PlantUML fan, not affiliated with PlantUML; rendering happens locally via the official PlantUML JavaScript build
- [Privacy policy](https://plantuml-editor.com/privacy.html): no cookies, no tracking; fonts and icons are self-hosted; third-party servers are only contacted for content users include themselves (e.g. the PlantUML standard library from plantuml.github.io)
- [Terms of service](https://plantuml-editor.com/terms.html): private, free project, provided as is
- [Legal notice](https://plantuml-editor.com/imprint.html): provider identification (German: impressum.html)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Hakenadu/plantuml-power-editor)
- [PlantUML language reference](https://plantuml.com/)
